questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop and look in all directions before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, slow down and look and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction and maintenance work ahead. Slow down and be extra careful when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve right first and then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and let any trains pass before you cross the tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed to navigate the turn safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep slope, and the underside of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully and be prepared to slow down or wait.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be prepared to stop for a red light or slow down for a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down to maintain control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps to tell you not to continue in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp turn. Slow down before reaching the curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. However, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on road and weather conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. You cannot legally turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to prevent collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and allow vehicles and pedestrians to cross in front of you. Stop if necessary before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive on the side shown by the arrow. An island, median, or barrier is ahead, and you must stay on the correct side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A left turn.
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Cyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A left arm extended straight out signals an intent to turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.
